subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers that reject prompt messages in `input`, should OpenClaw support an explicit strict-relay compatibility mode, extend existing developer-role compat semantics, or decline core support for that relay class?
rationale: The reported failure is real enough to keep open, but the request-shape default affects multiple incompatible OpenAI-compatible provider families and may create a public config contract.

options.title: Sponsor default-preserving compat
options.body: Keep current defaults and support a documented opt-in such as an instructions-placement switch or maintainer-approved extension of existing compat semantics.

options.title: Flip reasoning Responses to developer
options.body: Make reasoning custom Responses models send `developer` by default, accepting the known regression risk for providers that reject developer role.

options.title: Decline this relay class
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged and direct affected operators to `openai-completions` or provider-specific external workarounds.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-preserving compat
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults and support a documented opt-in such as an instructions-placement switch or maintainer-approved extension of existing compat semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most directly related merged developer-role compatibility change in the current Responses transport history.
